Name: Ladder Outline
Author: ogahalo00
Description:
[b]LadderOutline[/b] is a mod inspired by two other popular mods: [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22052]Ladder Light[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3094]Ladder Locator[/url][/b]. This mod adds a visible [b]outline around ladders that lead to the next floor in the mines[/b], making them much easier to spot—especially in dark or cluttered areas. It's designed to improve visibility and help players quickly locate the way forward during mining.

🛠️ Installation Guide:[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have [b]Stardew Valley[/b] installed.
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] (version [b]3.18[/b] or newer is required).
[*]Download this mod and [b]extract it into your folder. [code]..\Stardew Valley\Mods[/code][/b]
[*](Optional) Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] for easy in-game configuration.
[/list]⚙️ Configuration (default config.jsonfile):
[code]﻿{
  "DebugMode": false,
  "EnableMod": true,
  "OutlineColor": "Green",
  "OutlineOpacity": 0.7,
  "ToggleKey": "None"
}
[/code][*][b]DebugMode[/b]: Enables debugging features (for development).
[*][b]EnableMod[/b]: Turns the mod on or off.
[*][b]OutlineColor[/b]: The color of the outline around the ladder.
[*][b]OutlineOpacity[/b]: Transparency level of the outline.
[*][b]ToggleKey[/b]: Optional hotkey to toggle the mod on/off.
